deliverables: Open, standardized interface across Cardano on-chain protocols
12 additional protocol onboardings over 12 months, three per quarter
Developer and agent coverage for onboarded protocols
MCP server for agents to discover and call published protocols
Auto-generated SDKs in multiple languages and live JSON-RPC endpoints
request.recipient: 2026 Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address stake1784sdxt6jjennmstphgdu7l7c2scf5d02a6cve2dgn5s2kq5u3j9v, submitted by Intersect on behalf of the vendor TxPipe
request.what: Withdraw treasury funds for Tx3 by TxPipe, an open API layer for Cardano dApp protocols with developer and agent-facing infrastructure.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 1,308,000 ADA plus a 327,000 ADA contingency reserve over 12 months, with a total withdrawal of 1,684,050 ADA including a 49,050 ADA Intersect administration fee.
Tx3 is intended to provide an open, standardized interface for Cardano protocols through documentation, multi-language SDKs, and live JSON-RPC endpoints.
The proposal states there is currently no common interface mechanism across the Cardano ecosystem, forcing integrators to relearn each protocol and raising integration costs.
The proposer claims AI agents will increase on-chain activity and require shared, auditable, deterministic protocol interfaces to avoid irreversible mistakes from hallucinated transactions.
Through Catalyst Fund 14, TxPipe has already put the developer layer into production with five protocols live on the Tx3 Protocol Registry at tx3.land.
The proposal funds 12 additional protocol onboardings, three per quarter, plus development of the MCP server and skill framework as shared infrastructure for registry protocols.
The proposal says it achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase.
The proposer states the requested amount does not breach the applicable 350M ADA Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 at the time of submission.
TxPipe has received funding through 30 Project Catalyst proposals from Funds 9 through 14, with 26 delivered and four currently under development and on schedule.

Intersect plans to administer funds through Sundae Labs treasury management smart contracts with specified reserve and project-specific addresses, external oversight entities, milestone-based disbursement controls, and a public dashboard.

summary: The document requests 1,684,050 ADA for TxPipe's Tx3 project, administered by Intersect through smart contracts, to expand protocol registry coverage and add agent-oriented API infrastructure over 12 months.
